name: Water Proof Silicon Shoe Waterproof Rain Boots Cover
description:
Soft & Flexible Material: Made of ultra-soft, thick silicone with excellent elasticity and foldability. Easily fits in bags or luggage, saving space.

Non-Slip Sole: Durable sole with anti-slip lines for safe walking on rainy days while ensuring comfort.

Perfect Waterproofing: Seamless integrated design fully covers shoes to prevent leaks. Easy to wear and remove.

Easy to Clean: Washable and reusable. Simply wipe with a towel or brush, add detergent for better cleaning.

Wide Application: Ideal for cycling, motorbiking, hiking, beach walks, gardening, farming, golf courses, or for guests entering homes without removing shoes.

Material: Premium Silicone
Reusable | Portable | Waterproof | Durable
